about_the_game:
Jump, climb, and pose!

Did you know there's a frog city inside a well?

It's a huge well—with land at the bottom, many little houses, and even a park with a fountain in the middle!

The city has been around for a long time and has several legends.

One of the most famous of them says:

“We must never enter the small wells around the city.”

But you know how kids are—telling them “don’t go” only makes them more curious!

Frog children sneak into those forbidden wells to play and explore.

They believe that if a frog climbs the highest spot and looks the coolest, their wish will come true.

🐸 Outline

This is a 3D action game where you climb steps from a third-person view.

Every time you jump to a new steps, you earn points—so aim for the highest score!

But be careful:

If your score doesn’t reach the stage’s goal, or if you fall and splash into the water... it’s game over.

You can only do two things:

  • Jump

  • Use your special move—strike a super cool pose!

When you strike a pose, special items appear that can boost your score or give other helpful effects.

The cooler your pose, the better the items you’ll get!

🐸 Feature

  • A third-person 3D action game

  • Jump and climb steps without falling

  • Use special moves to boost your score

🐸 Staff

Planning, Production, Artworks : Yamacoo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe / NVIDIA GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don’t fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards.
